I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it makes the next purchase feel like a big risk, especially with plants that you’re investing time and care into.

a bit about our quality so you know what you’re getting:

Our roses are grown on their own roots, not grafted, so they are longer-lived and come back true to variety if they die back.
Plants are virus-free and grown at our nurseries in Oregon, then defoliated before shipping so they travel well and arrive healthy and hydrated.
We ship in containers with soil, not bare root, and include planting instructions to help them establish.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, and perennials by a 90-day guarantee, as long as they are planted and cared for within our guidelines.
